description: Historically supported relations between South, East and Southeast Asian entities on 20 September 1378, keyed by country-catalogue ids (new records by their research ids), from start-date/research/asia.md. A missing pair means nothing is recorded, not Neutral. Relations naming a realm outside these regions (hormuz, mamluk) are this region's half of a cross-region pair. entities: 1378 realms that are neither map nations nor catalogue records yet.

Firuz Shah's raid on Jajnagar (1360) forced the Eastern Ganga king to promise elephant tribute; how far it was still paid in 1378 is unclear.
